## Overview

MarkdStage v3.8.4 improves the Windows Desktop presenter and CLI workflow, including more
reliable packaged-app launches, current-workspace handling, Archify diagram imports, and
PowerPoint export diagnostics and recovery. It also adds Store-ready Windows packaging and
desktop skill installation guidance.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown workspaces. Update
version-pinned installations to the new release tag.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v3.8.4`. |
| Canvas Extension | Install `.github/extensions/markdstage` from the `v3.8.4` tag. |
| CLI | Update `@markdstage/markdstage` to version `3.8.4`. |
| Desktop | Use the v3.8.4 Windows package for the matching architecture. |
| Microsoft Store | Coming soon; submit the Store package after the GitHub release is published. |
